A second edge-case item about distinguishing an omitted effort field from a genuinely-cleared one critiques the already-accepted last-value-wins design this ticket explicitly mirrors from openSessionStartPass, not a new defect introduced here — dismissed (1 dismissed). No spec/story artifact was supplied, so acceptance did not run (no-spec round); blind and verification-gap lenses are out of scope for the compact profile and standards audit is not expected for this profile, so neither counts as a coverage gap. Confidence is low because this is a genuine no-spec round.

findings.title: Full-recompute branch still blanks effort/permission_mode
findings.problem: computeSessionEnvUpdate's input.full branch sets candidate = { ...resolved, effort: input.effort, permission_mode: input.permissionMode } with no fallback to the baseline, while the cheap-path branch two lines below (fixed by this ticket) falls back to last!.effort/last!.permission_mode when the hook payload's value is empty. onPostModelSwitch and onConfigChange both pass hookInput.effort?.level ?? '' straight through as input.effort, and BaseHookInput.effort is documented absent for session-lifecycle hooks and for models without effort support.
findings.impact: A PostModelSwitch or ConfigChange hook firing with no effort/permission_mode in its payload blanks the last-known value in the persisted agent.session.env snapshot via the full-recompute path, reintroducing the exact bug class this ticket fixes for the cheap path.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same baseline-preference fallback used in the else branch to the input.full branch: effort: input.effort || last?.effort || '', permission_mode: input.permissionMode || last?.permission_mode || ''.
